correctness.rationale: Because mu has no image beginning in 1 and any 1 is the last symbol of 01, 11 never occurs in its fixed point; 00,01,10 all occur in 01001. In the psi(mu^4) tiling the block lengths are 11 and 7, so a length-seven factor meets at most two blocks. Independently generated pair windows give exactly the nine listed factors: two isolated Parikh classes and the seven rotations of 0012012. Every intransitive group is contained in the full stabilizer of one of the 63 proper coordinate bipartitions, with complexity no smaller than that block group's; sorted restricted-color strings reproduce the published bipartition table and realize every value 5 through 9. For the transitive groups, ASU degree-seven data supply the exhaustive conjugacy types. An independent computation constructs four affine groups and the binary linear group by ordered bases, uses canonical orbit representatives for all factor permutations, and normalizes counts over the 5040 coordinate bijections by the independently calculated normalizer size of each representative. It reproduces all five histograms and none contains 4. For A7, adjust any odd matching permutation by an odd stabilizer interchanging equal letters; thus A7 and S7 give 3. This exhausts subgroups under their full ambient actions, not merely generator moves within the factor set.
residual_risks: Transitive classification imported from published permutation-group tables, not proved by the orbit code. No inference to arbitrary lengths.
